channel.title: SignalFx US1 incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from SignalFx US1's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Splunk Observability AI Assistant Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Monitoring phase complete. The issue has been resolved.

item.title: Splunk APM Troubleshooting MetricSets Delayed [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Delayed notifications on us1 [resolved]
item.description: The notification delivery delays have been fully resolved. All queued notifications have been processed and the system is now operating normally.

item.title: Splunk APM Monitoring MetricSets Dropped [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Small amount of Datapoints Being Dropped [resolved]
item.description: Datapoint ingest for new or reactivated metric time series was affected between 2:28 PM PST to 2:47 PM PST. There was partial data loss for new metric time series during that time period. This situation is now recovered.

item.title: Datapoints Being Dropped [resolved]
item.description: Datapoint ingest for new metric time series was affected between 10:37 AM PST and 10:39 AM PST. There was partial data loss for new metric time series during that time period. This situation is now recovered.

item.title: Splunk Observability Cloud Web Interface Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Please note that the Splunk Observability Cloud API was also affected during this incident.

item.title: GCP Cloud Monitoring metrics not fetched in US1 [resolved]
item.description: Between 1a PDT and 2:50a PDT, any GCP integration that had the "Sync all (dynamically) listed projects" setting enabled had some of the Cloud Monitoring data from GCP dropped. This issue has been resolved. Customers may see gaps in charts and detectors that use affected GCP Cloud Monitoring metrics. AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor metrics are not impacted.

item.title: MetricTimeSeries Creation Delayed [resolved]
item.description: The issue causing delays in newly created metric time series has been resolved. Metric time series creation is operating normally. Datapoint ingestion for existing time series was not affected.

item.title: A partial outage of Splunk APM Tag Spotlight [resolved]
item.description: We have confirmed that the issue affecting Tag Spotlight has been resolved. Customers may have experienced limited functionality within Tag Spotlight beginning at approximately 4:30 PM PT on June 30. Full functionality was restored at 7:20 AM PT on July 1.

item.title: Logs correlation experience from a APM TraceView page was broken. [resolved]
item.description:
Due to a regression in a recent release, users navigating from Logs Related Content on the APM TraceView page to Log Observer were redirected back to APM TraceView instead. This impacted the Logs Correlation experience for customers across all realms, except US3 and Gov.
The change has been reverted to restore the expected navigation experience. Product availability for APM and Log Observer was not impacted; the issue was limited to the Logs Correlation workflow from TraceView.
Incident Start Time: 05:09 PDT, June 25, 2026 Incident End Time: 22:15 PDT, June 25, 2026

item.title: RUM API Endpoints Experienced Partial Downtime [resolved]
item.description: Rum API Endpoints were not available for one of our IPs, resulting in degraded service or a partial outage at first, and possibly a complete outage towards the end. This issue occurred from 4:22pm PST to 4:57pm PST

item.title: Datapoint ingest is affected [resolved]
item.description:
Our engineering team has confirmed that all the services recovered as of 4:55 PM PDT and remained stable during monitoring.
This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Splunk Observability Synthetic Monitoring Results Processing delayed [resolved]
item.description: We have identified and remediated an issue affecting synthetic test result ingestion for a subset of customers. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and thank you for your patience. Time range of impact: June 1 20:00 UTC - June 2 15:30 UTC

item.title: Charts not Loading, App and UI availability is also impacted [resolved]
item.description: This Incident has been resolved.

item.title: AWS CloudWatch metrics dropped [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. We have since confirmed that only AWS CloudWatch metrics were impacted during this incident. Azure and GCP metrics were not impacted.

item.title: RUM ingestion Failing [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Charts not Loading [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: RUM MMS Data Drop — Missing Chart & Dashboard Data [resolved]
item.description:
The outage impacting RUM MMS Data Drop has been resolved after internal engineering teams deployed a fix. All systems are operational and stable.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

item.title: RUM MMS Data Drop — Missing Chart & Dashboard Data [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting Real User Monitoring (RUM) custom charts and dashboards across multiple realms has been resolved. The fix has been deployed, and data is now flowing normally.

item.title: Charts, dashboards and detectors loading is delayed [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. We have confirmed that system stability has been restored, and performance for charts, dashboards, and detectors has returned to normal levels. Thank you.

item.title: Splunk APM Monitoring MetricSets Delayed [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting trace monitoring metrics in the US1 region is now resolved. All the APM monitoring sets are now fully operational and performing as expected. We confirm that no data was lost. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Splunk APM Trace Data Ingestion Delayed [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved, and data processing performance is now stable. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: New APM Data is Delayed [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved and services have returned to normal operation. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Synthetics tests running from Bahrain may not run on schedule [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Potential Cloud Integration Issues In UAE Region [resolved]
item.description:
Monitoring over the past several days has not identified any impact to Splunk Observability Cloud services related to the previously reported cloud service provider disruption in the Middle East.
Splunk Observability Cloud services continue to operate normally. We will continue to monitor the situation and will notify customers if conditions change.

item.title: Dashboard and Detectors are not loading [resolved]
item.description: We have completed the remediation actions and have successfully resolved the incident. At this time, no further action is required of you.

item.title: Data Management Page is not loading [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Splunk APM Interface Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: We have completed the rollback of the recent change affecting Splunk APM metrics and dashboards successfully. After closely monitoring the environment to verify a full recovery, our teams have confirmed that all services are functioning as expected. This incident has been Resolved.

item.title: Metrics from AWS Cloudwatch were not fetched partially [resolved]
item.description: Between 2026-01-23 at 3:30 AM PT and 2026-01-26 at 1:00 AM PT, metrics fetching from AWS Cloudwatch was degraded.
